thread:
acme_integration: Hey team — our integration started failing after we updated the client SDK. Getting a 400 from the tool call endpoint when sending file paths.
ashley_support: Sorry you're seeing that. Can you paste the exact request body you sent (redact secrets)?
acme_integration: Sure — minimal repro below. We call the tools API with tool args as a raw string. It's failing on the JSON parse.
acme_integration: ```json
{"path":"C:\\Users\\deploy\\data.json",}
```
acme_integration: Error returned: `400 Bad Request - Invalid tool args: Unexpected token } in JSON at position 36`.
jamal_eng: Looks like a trailing comma AND Windows backslashes. The trailing comma would be a parse error; backslashes need escaping if you're embedding JSON as a string. Which client are you using?
acme_integration: Node 18, using the official SDK (.toolCall) — we pass tool args as a string: `toolCall({ name: 'parser', args: payloadString })` where payloadString is JSON.stringify(fileObj). We didn't change how we build the string.
sophie_oncall: toolbot just logged a similar error from another customer earlier today. @jamal_eng might be a regression in the SDK where it double-wraps the string.
ashley_support: @acme_integration can you try removing the trailing comma and ensure you escape backslashes twice if sending as a JS string literal? Example repro:
acme_integration: Tried this and still failing (pasted below):
acme_integration: ```js
const payload = JSON.stringify({ path: "C:\\\\Users\\\\deploy\\\\data.json" });
await client.toolCall('parser', payload);
```
acme_integration: Error now: `Invalid tool args: Expected JSON object for "args", got string`.
jamal_eng: Ah — SDK expects a JS object (not a pre-stringified JSON) for tool args unless you use the raw string variant. There's been confusion about allowed types. What does your callsite look like? Full snippet?
acme_integration: Full snippet:
acme_integration: ```js
const payload = JSON.stringify({ path: "C:\\\\Users\\\\deploy\\\\data.json" });
await client.toolCall({ name: 'parser', args: payload });
```
jamal_eng: There — you're passing a string into args. SDK will attempt to validate the args against the tool schema and fails because it's not an object. Two options: pass the object directly (no JSON.stringify) or if the tool schema declares a single string param, send a string. E.g. `args: { path: "C:\\Users\\deploy\\data.json" }`.
acme_integration: That fixed the validation error, thanks — but we still see inconsistent behavior across environments. In CI (linux) the path is `/data/file.json` no escaping needed. Locally (windows) we hit these backslash issues.
sophie_oncall: Repro steps I suggest we add to the ticket for eng:
- OS: Windows 11, Node 18.14
- SDK: @latest 2.3.1
- Call: client.toolCall({ name: 'parser', args: { path: "C:\\Users\\deploy\\data.json" } })
- Observed: 400 Invalid tool args when SDK serializes args to wire format in Windows only
- Expected: 200 + tool invocation queued
jamal_eng: I'll try to reproduce. One hypothesis: our internal serializer was trimming escape sequences on Windows when converting objects to the wire format, which would break JSON validity. @toolbot can you fetch the last serializer patch logs from the build tagged `sdk/2.3.1`?
toolbot: Fetching logs for tag sdk/2.3.1... found 2 commits touching serializer.js: 8a7c9b and 9f3d2e. Posting diff excerpt.
toolbot: ```diff
-  const raw = JSON.stringify(args).replace(/\\\\/g, "\\");
+  const raw = JSON.stringify(args);
```
jamal_eng: Oof — earlier change tried to normalize backslashes (bad idea). That replace would collapse double-escaped backslashes into single, but when later embedded in a string it can end up unescaped on the wire -> invalid JSON. Going to test reverting that locally.
ashley_support: For customer-facing workaround: tell them to pass args as an object (avoid manual JSON.stringify) and ensure they use double-escaped backslashes in string literals if they must stringify client-side. Example fix we can suggest in the ticket.
acme_integration: Workaround implemented, tests passing locally. Thanks for the triage. Can you escalate to eng for a proper SDK patch? We'll keep CI green for now.
jamal_eng: Filing a patch now and a unit test for Windows path serialization. I'll ping here when a release candidate is out. :thumbsup:
acme_integration: Appreciate it. Please include a note about trailing commas — we had that too in our original payload because of a codegen bug.
jamal_eng: Will do. Adding regression label and attaching the snippets you shared. ETA for RC: ~2 business days.
sophie_oncall: Marking this thread for follow-up. If anyone else sees variants (single quotes, raw strings, BOMs), drop a quick repro here and we'll add to the test matrix. :pray:
acme_integration: Will report back if we hit more. Thanks all!
